outline:
先修課程：3001011或負責教授同意。介紹結構體在受到張力、壓力、剪力、扭力及彎曲等外力狀態下之變形，分析應力、應變及變形，莫耳圓、壓力容器、樑、柱。
Prerequisite: ME111 or Consent of Instructor
Introduction of the deformation, strain and stress of structures (Beam, Column, Pressure vessel) under several different loading conditions such as Tension, Compression, Shear force, Torsion and Bending moment.

2 9/17 Chap. 1 Stress

4 10/1 Chap. 3 Material properties
5 10/8 Chap. 3 Material properties in rail systems Quiz 1

7 10/22 Chap. 4.5~4.8 Axial loading in rail systems
8 10/29 Chap. 5 Torsion
9 11/5 Midterm Exam
10 11/12 Chap. 6 Bending
11 11/19 Chap. 6 Bending in rail systems
12 11/26 Chap. 7 Transverse shear and rail systems
13 12/3 Chap. 8 Combined loading
14 12/10 Chap. 8 Combined loading Quiz 2
15 12/17 Chap. 9 Stress transformation
16 12/24 Chap. 12 Deflection of beams and rail systems
17 12/31 Chap. 13 Buckling and rail systems
18 1/7 Final Exam
materials: R. C. Hibbeler Mechanics of Materials. 10th edition in SI unit
